item.title: Debunking the 30 Total Engineers Hype at X
item.description:
The recent viral claims about X running on just 30 engineers have sparked a lot of celebration in certain circles, posts framing it as proof that massive layoffs + extreme leanness = superior efficiency.

But let’s challenge the terminology and add some missing context before everyone rushes to declare small-team supremacy the new universal truth on X.

What Nikita Bier actually said (Jan 10, 2026):

“We only have ~30 engineers on the product but they’re the best in the business” — @nikitabier, replying to @BillyM2k and @BoredElonMusk
